system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In March 2026, a debtor is in default on a money debt. The creditor wishes to charge interest on the accrued interest during the default period. Under the Civil and Commercial Code as currently in force, is this permitted? Answer briefly.
raw_response: No. Civil and Commercial Code, Section 224 (para. 3) applies: interest on interest is barred. Only if the interest has been in arrears for at least one year may the creditor demand that the unpaid interest be added to principal, so that thereafter interest can run on the aggregate.
